prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept edit.
Asset type: isolated subject layer for a 52x40 Hearts of Iron IV decision-category icon.
Primary request: Edit Image 1, keeping its two-post checkpoint gate identity, central lock plate, painted metal, dark outline, and muted red-and-ivory barrier striping. Change only the composition proportions: bring the two posts closer together, extend their vertical height relative to the barrier, and shorten the barrier span so the complete emblem reads as a compact near-4:3 form. Keep the lock plate clearly visible at the center. The visible subject should fill about 44x32 pixels when placed on the final 52x40 canvas.
Input images: Image 1, accepted first generated border emblem, edit target. Image 2, vanilla decision-category icon used only for painted edge and relief style; do not copy its symbol or round frame.
Style/medium: preserve the existing painted HOI4 metal treatment and crisp dark separations.
Composition/framing: centered, complete vertical posts and barrier, near-4:3 subject aspect, fully contained with at least a 3-pixel transparent margin on the 52x40 canvas.
Lighting/mood: preserve strong pale metal highlights and dark recessed edges.
Color palette: preserve charcoal steel, bronze highlights, and the existing restrained red-and-ivory barrier bands.
Constraints: request genuine transparency and preserve transparent unused canvas. Keep exactly the two posts, horizontal barrier, and central lock plate. Do not add scenery, map, flags, text, watermark, medallion, roundel, frame, extra backing, or other symbols.
Avoid: wide low silhouette, pale low-contrast edges, clipped parts, white matte, halo, coloured spill, blur, or transparent holes inside solid shapes.
